SELECT StuID
FROM Student
WHERE StuID NOT IN (
    SELECT H.StuID
    FROM Has_Pet H
    JOIN Pets P ON H.PetID = P.PetID
    WHERE P.PetType = 'cat'
);
FINAL SQL:
SELECT StuID
FROM Student
WHERE StuID NOT IN (
    SELECT H.StuID
    FROM Has_Pet H
    JOIN Pets P ON H.PetID = P.PetID
    WHERE P.PetType = 'cat'
);
